messages:
mira: Quick thread — customer asks: per-tenant legal-hold + region-bound retention with cost allocation. Need a realistic scope and launch criteria.

owen: Can we break this into three deliverables? 1) Per-tenant hold flag + immutable audit entry; 2) Regionally-scoped retention policy; 3) Billing attribution for extra retention.

samira: Security: must ensure immutable audit entries are write-once and include requestor identity + signed timestamp. For region lock, keys must never leave region when BYOK is used.

nik: Eng infra: region lock for data routing is doable at storage layer, but search/indexing across regions complicates exports. We could offer region-limited exports (export runs inside region) as a start.

gara: Finance/CS: customers expect clear pricing for >90d retention. Suggest a per-GB-month surcharge and a one-time export fee for bulk e-discovery.

mira: Proposed MVP (narrow):
- Feature A: tenant-level legal-hold toggle that prevents data deletion and creates immutable audit event.
- Feature B: retention tiers (90d default, 1y, 5y) with region tag and region-local export by default.
- Feature C: pricing table + cost allocation labels applied to tenant billing.

owen: Tech constraints/notes:
- Legal-hold prevents TTL-based deletions but not necessarily immediate physical immutability (need deep-archive policies).
- Region-local export means we may need to spin up a short-lived export worker in the region (ops overhead).

samira: BYOK notes: for region-locked BYOK, require customer KMS ARN scoped to that region and an attestation checkbox in onboarding. HSM attestation optional for later. Also add key-rotation notification SLA for keys used for retention.

gara: Billing: ops needs a retention label in the usage pipeline. Propose two metrics: retention GB-months and export GB. We'll map retention GB-months to invoice line-item.

nik: Scaling/ops ask: how many customers will opt in? If small, prefer pilot with manual exports to avoid spinning regional infra. We need clear pilot gating.

owen: UX: surface a warning when enabling >1y retention: estimated monthly cost, export ETA disclaimer, and BYOK requirement if region lock selected.

mira: Launch criteria suggestion:
- Legal-hold toggle present in console + immutable audit log entries emitted and stored.
- Region-tagged retention tiers enforceable (no cross-region index leakage) for pilot tenants.
- Export-from-region flow validated end-to-end for a sample 500GB dataset (resumeable).
- Billing pipeline includes retention GB-month metric and invoice-ready mapping.
- Security sign-off on BYOK region-scope checklist (pilot mode allowed without HSM).

samira: Security will draft the BYOK region checklist and the immutable-audit spec.

gara: Finance will draft pricing buckets and the invoice mapping.

ik: Eng infra will propose pilot capacity plan and ops runbook for region-based exports.

owen: PM will own UX copy + warnings and coordinate pilot customers.

mira: Action items:
- nik: pilot infra plan + ops runbook (2w).
- samira: BYOK region checklist + audit spec (1w).
- gara: pricing buckets + billing labels (1w).
- owen: UX copy & pilot recruiting (1w).
Ill put this in the compliance drive and tag pilot customers.
